name: Mayra Batalla
bio: Mayra Batalla is an actress, known for "Qué le dijiste a Dios? (2014)", "¿Qué culpa tiene el niño? (2016)" and "Partes usadas (2007)" among other mexican movies.

credits.title: Answer
credits.overview: Every afternoon, Mateo stops at a phone booth to make a call. His mother sees these calls as dangerous fantasies she fears encouraging. But in resisting, she faces a harder question: whether her denial is what's pushing her son away.

credits.title: A Child of My Own
credits.overview: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

credits.title: Beyond the Waves: The Ballad of Alba
credits.overview: On the coasts of Sinaloa, Mexico, in 1897, Alba, a mysterious fisherwoman, takes a peculiar runaway bride named Aurora aboard her rowboat. Together, they embark on an unlikely adventure across the sea to change their fate and, along the way, discover an intense awakening that will intertwine their lives forever.

credits.title: I Am Mario
credits.overview: Mario is a trans taxi driver who gets pregnant. He has the possibility of fulfilling his desire to become a father, but this confronts him with his expectations regarding his masculinity. Before exposing himself to a "macho" and prejudice-filled society, he must face himself.

credits.title: El diablo en el camino
credits.overview: After the Cristero War in rural Mexico, a carpenter must carry the body of his young son across a devastated landscape haunted by the devil.

credits.title: Counterattack
credits.overview: When a hostage rescue mission creates a new enemy, Capt. Guerrero and his elite soldiers must face an ambush by a criminal group.

credits.overview: A man searches for his father, Pedro Páramo, in a town doomed by violence and the fury of a frustrated love.

credits.overview: The queen (Reyna) celebrates her roots and her encounter with the pleasure of being a woman.

credits.title: Huesera: The Bone Woman
credits.overview: Valeria's joy at becoming a first-time mother is quickly taken away when she's cursed by a sinister entity. As danger closes in, she's forced deeper into a chilling world of dark magic that threatens to consume her.

credits.title: Iguana Like the Sun
credits.overview: In a humble coastal tropical compound, amidst a total eclipse of the sun, an unexpected guest arouses the broken dreams of a family that has lost its guardian figure, overshadowed by the cosmic loneliness where they were left to their faith.

credits.title: MexZombies
credits.overview: A group of teenagers must face a zombie apocalypse, and help reestablish order.

credits.title: Prayers for the Stolen
credits.overview: Ana and her two best friends, Maria and Paula, navigate life in their oppressive countryside village. Whilst their families struggle in the poppy fields harvesting opium, the girls try to grow alongside the creeping terror of their cartel oppressors.

credits.title: Cindy La Regia
credits.overview: When Cindy decides that she doesn't want to marry her boyfriend, she runs to Mexico City, where new friendships and unexpected paths teach her that there are so much more possibilities on her life and her talent than she imagines.

credits.title: You Live for Me
credits.overview: A tale about the fragile lives of four characters during a month of their lives. One of them, Ana, is waiting for a kidney donor.

credits.title: Don't Blame the Kid
credits.overview: After a one-night stand results in pregnancy, a young woman decides to become partners with the emotionally immature father-to-be.

credits.title: The Load
credits.overview: Late sixteenth century. A Tameme Indian man and a noble Spanish woman flee through the forests of the New World in search of freedom. Their frantic journey softens the tension between them and dissolves their longstanding differences and creates intimate bonds that threaten their very survival.

credits.title: Get Married If You Can
credits.overview: Ana Paula catches her fiancé cheating. After a night of drinking, she wakes up far from home, not so certain she wants to go back.
